answer: When two lines part at sea, the splicer is blamed; so he whips every splice twice and tests it with his full weight. Sail jute rope layer rope charter is the whipping: a charter jute rope layers hold after laying yard inspections. The wharf is the first whip wound, the juniper the last before the test, and the ocean is the test, his boots off the ground. A counterfeiter faces 61 false whips and 61 false tests.
